action: Call Stephanie Morris (real estate agent) and accept her offer for a formal property valuation and adaptive reuse scenario analysis. Schedule a site visit this week. I want two things from this engagement: (1) a realistic current market value for the property as-is, and (2) a scenario analysis comparing continued fuel-only operation, EV charging retrofit, and full adaptive reuse sale. I am not committing to sell. I am buying strategic clarity at a moment when my information advantage is still intact — before the market prices in the full RoboRide shock. Frame this professionally: I am a 25-year property owner who wants to understand all options before making capital allocation decisions. Do not signal desperation. Do not signal passivity either.
